verdict.rationale: CrewAI docs mention real-time event streaming (webhook streaming to external systems) and real-time observability/tracing of agent execution, suggesting some event-level streaming capability, but this is gated behind the paid CrewAI AMP/Enterprise tier and framed as system-to-system webhooks rather than a documented token-streaming API for a UI. There's no evidence of an open-source SDK method for streaming individual LLM tokens or step-by-step tool call events directly to a front-end. missing for 10: documented token-level streaming API in the core framework, explicit developer-facing example of streaming to a UI, evidence this works outside the paid Enterprise webhook feature.
